lemma taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange_iteratedDeriv {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hx : x₀ ≠ x)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ (n + 1) f (uIcc x₀ x)) :
    ∃ x' ∈ uIoo x₀ x, f x - taylorWithinEval f n (uIcc x₀ x) x₀ x =
      iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f x' * (x - x₀) ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1)!
